preferences.title: Notification settings
preferences.description: How you are told of each kind of notification. They always show in the app.
preferences.mandatory: Required: you can change how often, not turn it off.
preferences.impersonating: While acting as someone, their notification settings stay theirs.

breach.banner: The password you signed in with appears in a known data breach. Change it now, to one you use nowhere else.
breach.settleFailed: Your password was changed, but the breach alert could not be marked as read.

phone.title: SMS number
phone.description: Where text messages are sent. A number is used only after you confirm the code texted to it.
phone.invalid: Enter the number with its country code, like +4915112345678.
phone.codeHint: The six-digit code we texted you. It lasts ten minutes.
phone.optedOutHint: This number replied STOP, so no text is sent. Reply START from it to receive texts again.
phone.removeDescription: No text messages will be sent to you.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Phones and browsers that receive push notifications. The mobile app registers phones; turn this browser on here.
devices.enabled: Push notifications are on for this browser.
devices.disabled: Push notifications are off for this browser.
devices.denied: The browser blocked notifications. Allow them in its site settings, then try again.
devices.removeDescription: {{name}} will stop receiving push notifications until the app registers it again.
